episodes.title: Russell Brand and the conspiracy theory playbook
episodes.description: After former entertainer Russell Brand was sentenced to 10-and-a-half-years in jail for one count of rape and three counts of sexual assault earlier this week, a corner of social media is pushing false claims and conspiracy theories in support of him. In this episode, Marianna and Matt discuss how this is increasingly a feature of a world where celebrities or powerful people who are found guilty of wrongdoing, can rehabilitate themselves in the eyes of a cult conspiracy following online. Marianna messages some of the people sharing this content and asks them what they really believe and why. Plus the CEO of tech giant Nvidia Jensen Huang has resigned after it emerged he was allegedly having affairs - including one with someone suspected to be a Chinese spy. Matt and Marianna explore what led to his resignation - including assessing if the affairs were honey-potting, or, as some people are saying online, honey-dicking? Arguably the whole global economy has been affected by one guy in a leather jackets libido. Top Comment is hosted by Marianna Spring and Matt Shea. Made by Emma Close and Sophie Milward. The technical producer was Jonny Hall. The editor is Justine Lang. The senior news editor is Sam Bonham.
